title: Trivial Constant Declarations
pattern: Defining symbolic constants for values whose meaning is universally obvious and carries no risk of change.
why_bad: Adds an extra line of indirection and name tracking for a trivial value that has no symbolic meaning, increasing cognitive load.
detection: Constant declarations mapping to universally static numbers (like 1, 0, or empty string) with names that merely repeat the value.
counterexample: Configurable parameters, math constants (like PI), or complex magic numbers that control specific layout/business logic.
fix: Replace references with the raw literal value and delete the constant.
